mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 units, indicating strengthening demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always-on.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, signaling a tight labor market, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in the previous month, the combined effect drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators impact on consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in two consecutive months indicates strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) over the previous quarter, indicating a growing economy, consistently leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth impact on equity markets
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 5.5%, signaling monetary tightening, and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% over the previous 6 months, the combined effect leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced borrowing and spending.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.5% and CPIAUCSL growth > 3% over 6 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Low unemployment rates (UNRATE) below the historical average, indicating a strong labor market, consistently lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market strength impact on short-term equity performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% over two consecutive months, signaling weakening demand, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
